## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] `manifest.json` is valid and all required metadata is complete.
- [ ] The declared entry point exists and is documented.
- [ ] Skill instructions and supporting files were reviewed for correctness.
- [ ] The submission status is `under_review`.
- [ ] The skill contains no secrets, tokens, or other sensitive data.
- [ ] The skill contains no Perforce (`p4`) commands.
